_comment: The ibrat queue: one everyday SITUATION per entry, and the verse that closes the video on it. Both are chosen by hand and neither is the model's to pick — the situation because a model asked daily for a good one converges inside a fortnight (see content.py), and the verse because a model asked to find scripture that fits a story will always find something that sounds like it fits. That is the single failure this whole format has to not have. `_ur` is there so the file can be read by eye; nothing uses it. Every verse here was fetched and measured before it was written down: all are under 200 characters of Urdu, because the translation is read aloud after a five-scene story and a long one puts the video past the minute. A hadith entry is {"topic": ..., "hadith": "<HadeethEnc id>"} and works the same way.
